scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT/GW+BSE outputs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; therefore result-level comparison with hidden gold plus structural trend verification is used (T3).

outputs.description: Table of gaps and binding energy per oxygen coverage. The hidden checker will compare each row's quantitative values to a hidden reference within tolerances, and also verify that optical gap varies systematically while HOMO-LUMO gap remains essentially constant across oxygen numbers.

output_contract.notes: The agent must compute the quantities genuinely; the checker uses result-level comparison (T0) augmented by trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold table for result comparison
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (binding energies) and Figure 5 (optical and HOMO-LUMO gaps).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted the reported binding energies for Si20 and Si20O_m (m=0,1,2,4,6,8,10,12) from Table 1, and read approximate gap values from Figure 5a (HOMO-LUMO) and Figure 5b (optical gap).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are traceable to the source paper; binding energies match Table 1 exactly, and gap values are within the plotted ranges of Figure 5.

steps.description: Compare reported HOMO-LUMO gap, optical gap, and binding energy per atom against hidden gold within tolerances, and verify structural trends (optical gap varies, HOMO-LUMO constant).
